texts.hero-sub:
Stay consistent. See your progress.
No subscription, no login — just open and train.
texts.hero-price: 7 days of Streak Pro free · then keep logging and your streak for free, unlock the whole app once with Pro
texts.s1-body: The heatmap shows at a glance how active you were — the more intense the workout, the deeper the color. Active days glow, rest days are visible. Always keep your rhythm in view.
texts.s2-body: The week ring shows every day of the week as a segment — a workout fills it. Weekly goal reached, week streak, record: Streak shows it right away. These small moments keep you motivated to keep going day after day.
texts.s3-body: Sport, focus, duration and intensity — all in one sheet, with just a few taps. No long forms. Streak keeps logging as fast as the workout itself. Add custom sports and categories anytime.
texts.s4-body: All workouts, this week, month or full year — Streak shows charts, monthly heatmaps, volume and average heart rate per sport, and personal insights. Everything clear, all in one app.
texts.s5-body: Bright daylight or deep dark night mode — Streak follows the system automatically or can be fixed manually. On all devices, at any time of day.
texts.s6-body: In Dark Mode, the accent colors reveal their full elegance. Warm Orange or glowing Rose — both look especially refined in the dark. Choose the style that suits you.
texts.s7-body: Pick any accent color with the color picker — or one of the ready-made themes. Your choice applies everywhere: in the app, your widgets and on Apple Watch. With Streak Pro.
texts.vid-body: Calendar, statistics, strength logging and the Apple Watch app — in under 30 seconds.
texts.st-body: Log every exercise with sets, reps and weight. Streak calculates your volume and remembers your all-time records — all in the same fast logging sheet, no detours.
texts.w-body: Log your workout and see daily progress, weekly goal and streak right on Apple Watch. Average heart rate and energy of the session land in the entry automatically. With complications for your watch face — a single tap is enough.
texts.s8m-h2:
As simple
as you want it.
texts.s8m-body: Streak adapts to your style. If you just want to track, you get a clean calendar — no distractions. If you want to go deeper, enable Insights and see patterns, records, and training analytics.
texts.s8-body: Choose from 10 sport-specific background images or upload your own photo. Cards overlay as a Liquid Glass effect — soft, translucent. Clear glass, blur and dark overlay are freely adjustable.
texts.s9-body: Your name, your weekly goal (2–7× per week), motivation text on or off, daily reminders. Streak adapts to you — not the other way around. No forced features, no distractions.
texts.s10-body: Workouts from Apple Health and Apple Watch land in the day list on their own — with duration, energy and average heart rate. With Streak Pro you see the heart-rate curve and zones of every workout. Export your data as CSV or JSON, create backups and restore them. Your data stays with you: on your device or in your private iCloud.
texts.s10-p5: No workout data on our servers
